title: Book a shuttle pass and view the ticket
description: Verifies that a user can choose a route, select an available seat, book the shuttle, and reach the boarding pass ticket view.

steps.description: Navigate to /shuttle
Select a travel direction
Select an available seat
Book the shuttle pass
Verify the boarding pass ticket is displayed
Verify ticket details are visible

title: Switch campus context on the dashboard
description: Verifies that a user can change the active campus on the dashboard and see the campus-specific service trackers update.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Toggle the active campus context
Verify the active campus changes
Verify the visible tracker information updates for the selected campus

title: Select a merch size, add to cart, and checkout
description: This test verifies that a user can choose a size, add a merch item to the cart, review the cart, and complete checkout.

steps.description: Navigate to /merch
Select a product from the catalog
Choose a size for the product
Add the item to the cart
Open the cart view
Complete checkout
Verify the checkout confirmation is visible
Verify the ordered merch item is shown in the completion view

title: Adjust canteen cart quantity and complete checkout
description: Verifies that a user can remove an item from the cart using quantity controls and then place the order successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /canteen
Add a menu item to the cart
Decrease the item quantity using the cart control
Checkout the order
Verify the live order tracker is displayed
Verify an order status pipeline is visible

title: Submit a print job and receive pickup details
description: This test verifies that a user can select a print shop, configure a print job, submit it, and see pickup confirmation details.

steps.description: Navigate to /print
Select a print shop
Configure the number of pages for the print job
Choose valid print options for color and sidedness
Submit the document for printing
Verify a pickup PIN confirmation is visible
Verify print job details are displayed

title: Browse canteen items by category and add food to cart
description: Verifies that a user can filter canteen items by category and add an item to the cart from the filtered results.

steps.description: Navigate to /canteen
Filter the menu by a category
Add a menu item to the cart
Verify the cart contains an item
Verify the filtered menu results remain visible

title: Choose merch size and complete checkout from the cart
description: Verifies that a user can select a product size, add the item to the cart, open the cart, and finish checkout.

steps.description: Navigate to /merch
Select a product size
Add the product to the cart
Open the cart panel
Checkout the cart
Verify the checkout confirmation is displayed
Verify the cart is empty or cleared after checkout

title: Submit a print job and receive a pickup PIN
description: Verifies that a user can complete a print submission and see the generated pickup PIN confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /print
Select a print shop
Configure the print options
Submit the print job
Verify a pickup PIN confirmation is displayed
Verify the print submission summary is visible

title: Open the print hub and start a print submission
description: Verifies that a user can enter the print hub and begin configuring a document print submission.

steps.description: Navigate to /print
Select a print shop
Configure the page count and print options
Verify print submission controls are visible
Verify a print configuration summary is displayed

title: Book the opposite shuttle route with a different seat
description: Verifies that a user can switch to the opposite campus route, choose another available seat, and generate a valid ticket.

steps.description: Navigate to /shuttle
Select the opposite campus route
Select a different available seat
Book the shuttle pass
Verify the boarding pass ticket is displayed
Verify the ticket reflects the selected route

title: View dashboard service shortcuts for the active campus
description: Verifies that the dashboard shows the expected service shortcuts and trackers for the current campus context.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the dashboard landing content is displayed
Verify active shuttle and canteen tracker information is visible

title: Browse merch by organization and mark a product as favorite
description: This test verifies that a user can filter merchandise by organization and favorite a product while browsing the catalog.

steps.description: Navigate to /merch
Filter products by an organization
Open a product from the filtered results
Mark the product as a favorite
Verify the filtered merchandise results are displayed
Verify the product is saved as a favorite

title: Continue canteen order tracking after checkout
description: Verifies that after checkout a user can view the live tracking page for the placed canteen order.

steps.description: Navigate to /canteen
Add a menu item to the cart
Checkout the order
Open the order tracker view
Verify the live order tracker is displayed
Verify the order progress stages are visible

title: Update merch cart contents before checkout
description: This test verifies that a user can add merch to the cart, adjust the cart contents, and still proceed to checkout successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /merch
Select a product from the catalog
Choose a size for the product
Add the item to the cart
Open the cart view
Adjust the cart contents before checkout
Complete checkout
Verify the cart review is displayed
Verify a checkout confirmation is visible

title: Change print settings before submitting a document
description: This test verifies that a user can update print options before submission and still complete the print flow successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /print
Select a print shop
Configure the number of pages for the print job
Choose one set of valid print options for color and sidedness
Change the print options to a different valid combination
Submit the document for printing
Verify a successful submission confirmation is visible
Verify pickup details are displayed

title: Browse merch by organization and save a favorite product
description: Verifies that a user can filter merchandise by organization and mark a product as a favorite.

steps.description: Navigate to /merch
Filter merchandise by organization
Favorite a product
Verify the filtered product list is displayed
Verify the product is marked as a favorite

title: Use a different print shop for a new submission
description: This test verifies that a user can switch to another print shop and still submit a print job successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /print
Select a print shop
Change to a different print shop
Configure the number of pages for the print job
Choose valid print options for color and sidedness
Submit the document for printing
Verify the selected print shop is reflected in the confirmation
Verify a pickup PIN confirmation is visible

title: See validation when submitting an incomplete print job
description: This test verifies that required print settings must be completed before submission and that validation is shown instead of a confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /print
Select a print shop
Attempt to submit the document without completing the remaining print settings
Verify a print validation error is visible
Verify pickup details are not displayed

title: Handle an empty merch filter result
description: Verifies that filtering merchandise to a category or organization with no items shows an empty state instead of products.

steps.description: Navigate to /merch
Apply a filter that yields no merchandise items
Verify an empty state message is visible
Verify no products are displayed

title: See merch empty-state guidance when no products match a filter
description: This test verifies that filtering merchandise to a category with no matches shows an empty state instead of products.

steps.description: Navigate to /merch
Filter products by an organization with no matching products
Verify an empty state message is visible
Verify no merch products are displayed
